# supabase

_v0.1.0_

Edge Functions and local Supabase configuration

## Functions

- `ai` handles the Studio AI endpoints.
- `icons` proxies and caches game icons.

Each function owns its Deno dependency map and lockfile. Keep shared HTTP helpers in `functions/_shared`; app code shared with the browser belongs in `packages/shared`.

Deploy functions separately with `pnpm deploy:ai` or `pnpm deploy:icons` from this directory. Both require `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF`.

Set `AI_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` to the comma-separated hostnames the AI function may use as custom MCP servers.
